Strategy: Combine the roomy-first split at fifty with the sweet band and mid penalty, so roomy bins compete by worst fit while tight bins compete by best fit with band adjustments. This stacks two steering ideas, but the combination may overcomplicate ranking and the thresholds are guesses.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (((r - item) if r - item >= 50 else -(r - item)) + (20 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0)) for r in bins]
```
